appearance_epoch: 2025-05-01 facade; earlier dated views constrain hidden geometry only
status: Independent camera/width calibration applied; approximate photo reconstruction, not survey
height_basis: Independent EOS M2/21mm single-plane metric rectification using Canon 22.3 x 14.9mm sensor and frozen mapped frontage. See calibration-independent.json and controls. Rear wing remains proportional inference.

nominal_vertical_coordinates_m.meaning: The builder retains a 28.8/38.2m drafting frame for decorative silhouette and grooves, then maps it to heights_m. Front windows and entrance instead use photo_rectified_front_m, independently mapped to the 24.6/33.4m reference.

depth_basis: Observed order and nonzero thickness are photo constrained; precise depths are proportional modeling estimates.

observed_controls.observation: Four regular upper rows have 8 axes, narrow outer windows, paired wing windows, paired central windows. Do not extend 8-window repetition through the central entrance.
Ground strip, tall hall row and four regular window rows; two narrow-window rows in central tower.
Wide dark stone portal, lower double doors, large upper glazed grille, seven gold vertical bars, stepped dark transom, gold six-character plaque.
Tower extends west, side windows and stepped returns visible; central vertical crest is not a flat billboard.
Tall narrow blades at outer piers; lower flat wing parapets and small intermediate caps; highest masonry is central stepped crest, excluding flagpole.
White cement/render above black marble base/door frame; no whole-building cut-stone texture.

inferred_controls: Absolute heights are independently photo-calibrated estimates with documented point/camera/depth sensitivity, not surveyed elevations.
Rear wing roof level and its window counts are conservative multi-view/footprint reconstructions; west facade is not fully photographed.
Window recesses, frame widths, groove depths and roof slab thicknesses use photo proportions, not measured dimensions.
Tower side/rear window distribution beyond visible side windows is inferred and separately labeled in the geometry report.
excluded_epoch_details: night floodlight color baked into facade

lettering.method: Actual closed glyph extrusions from the shared licensed OFL subset; readable approximation, not photo-traced calligraphy. Small14 uses independent vector strokes.

photo_rectified_front_m.method: Approximate manual feature selection and colour-profile checks in original oriented pixels, mapped with independent plane H. Window depths and outer/inner portal offsets checked using the independent 3x4 projection. Symmetric axes average left/right estimates; no claim of sub-centimetre accuracy.

source_reference_resolution: Photo filenames are relative to research/. Literature IDs resolve through research/sources.json; full copyrighted article caches are not required or published.

photographic_glazing.method: Individually corrected, guarded per-glass-pane photo sampling; no whole-facade projection

glazing_rebate_revision.reason: Glass seated within existing frame rebate; previous pane plane was behind the whole deep grid, causing excessive direct-light occlusion. Same-construction procedural panes and photographic panes updated consistently; wall/frame/UV geometry unchanged.
